rules.serverNow: Freeze the server clock at case.serverNow for the whole case.
rules.given: Load given.rows into the tables and set the global rev counter to given.rev before the request. given.priorRequests = send the same request that many times first (same clock). given.rows.profiles (optional) are stored profiles; given.profileRev (default 0) sets the profile rev counter.
rules.rawBodyBytes: When present, the request body is that many bytes of the letter a, with a matching Content-Length.
rules.expectedResponseKeys: The JSON response has exactly these top-level keys.
rules.expectedResponse: Exact values. List order: presence by characterName, sightings by rev. Floats compare with a tolerance of 1e-6.
rules.expectedRows: Logical rows per table after the request. Each table holds exactly this many rows; each listed row matches one stored row on every listed column. observers compares as a sorted list. A table missing from expectedRows is not checked (page-limit leaves the 501 generated sightings unchecked).
rules.clientExpect: Receiver rule: hideRowKeys = the scan rowKeys a client may hide after merging the response sightings.
rules.rawBody: When present, send this exact text as the body (it may hold JSON that is not standard, such as NaN).
rules.fillerSightings: Generate count sightings rows from template, varied as the vary text says, before the request.
rules.expectedSightings: When present, check the sightings list by count and first/last rev instead of exact values; expectedResponse then omits sightings.
rules.expectedHeaders: Each listed response header is present. Retry-After holds whole seconds (1-60).
rules.problemDetails: Every response with a status of 400 or more is Content-Type application/problem+json (RFC 9457): type, title, status (the real status code), error (the v1 text), and detail or extension members such as field.
rules.keys: Seed every key with created_at = createdAt, role = role, revoked_at = 1.0 when revoked, last_seen null. The storage clock is frozen at case.serverNow too, so key expiry (30 days without use) is judged at that time.

keys.note: regular key, never used, created 31 days before the cases

cases.name: first-poll
cases.description: since 0 with one spice record: the server stores it, assigns rev 1, and echoes the caller's own sighting.

cases.name: ore-record
cases.description: a live ore node (cls ore, no fill or size) is stored and echoed like any other record; the server keeps it 3 hours, like spice.

cases.name: second-poll
cases.description: since = the previous next (1): only rows with rev > 1 come back; presence lists other members of the battlegroup, never the caller.

cases.name: foreign-partition
cases.description: a key from another battlegroup on another layout sees none of the stored rows: no sightings, no presence.

cases.name: other-layout
cases.description: same battlegroup, older Deep Desert layout: no sightings from layout deepdesert_1_07, but the roster (presence) is battlegroup-wide. position null = the member turned position sharing off.

cases.name: stale-two-keys
cases.description: a second key reports the same confirmed-stale row (same cls, type and 2000 cm cell) with a distance: one row, latest observation wins, observers holds both key ids, rev moves to 2. The receiver may hide the scan row.

cases.name: stale-one-key
cases.description: only one key reports the stale row: it is stored and returned, but one observer never hides a scan row.

cases.name: bad-key
cases.description: an unknown key id: 401, nothing stored.

expectedResponse.title: Key is not valid
expectedResponse.detail: The key is missing, unknown or revoked.

cases.name: revoked-key
cases.description: a revoked key: 401, nothing stored.

expectedResponse.title: Key is not valid
expectedResponse.detail: The key is missing, unknown or revoked.

cases.name: expired-key
cases.description: a regular key never used and created 31 days ago (over 30 days idle): 401 with type #key-expired, the same WWW-Authenticate, nothing stored.

expectedResponse.title: Key expired
expectedResponse.detail: The key was not used for 30 days. Ask the admin to renew it.

cases.name: too-big
cases.description: a body over 256 KB (262144 bytes): 413 before the body is parsed, nothing stored. rawBodyBytes = send that many bytes of the letter a as the body.

expectedResponse.title: Content Too Large
expectedResponse.detail: The body is over 262144 bytes, as sent or after inflating.

cases.name: rate-limited
cases.description: the same key already sent 30 requests in this minute (given.priorRequests, all at serverNow): the 31st gets 429 with a Retry-After header in whole seconds (1-60).

cases.name: bad-shape
cases.description: an unknown record class: 400 naming the field; the whole request is rejected, nothing stored.

expectedResponse.title: Request body is invalid
expectedResponse.detail: records[0].cls is missing, unknown or out of range

cases.name: health
cases.description: GET /health needs no key.

cases.name: not-found
cases.description: any other path: 404.

cases.name: method-not-allowed
cases.description: GET on a POST route: 405 with an Allow header naming POST, nothing stored.

cases.name: wrong-content-type
cases.description: a valid key with a body that is not sent as application/json: 415, nothing stored.

cases.name: non-finite-number
cases.description: sentAt is NaN (Python's json module accepts it by default; the server must not): 400 naming the field, nothing stored.

expectedResponse.title: Request body is invalid
expectedResponse.detail: sentAt is missing, unknown or out of range

cases.name: too-many-records
cases.description: 201 records (the limit is 200): 400 naming records, nothing stored.

expectedResponse.title: Request body is invalid
expectedResponse.detail: records is missing, unknown or out of range

cases.name: page-limit
cases.description: given.fillerSightings holds 501 rows in the caller's partition: one response returns only the first 500 (rev 1-500) and next = 500, so the client polls again for the rest.

fillerSightings.vary: row i (1..501) = template with rev = i, x = i * 2000.0, cellX = i

cases.name: presence-leaving
cases.description: presence (optional, /v1 additive): the caller says goodbye with leaving true; nextS 900 is clamped to 600. States come from server time only: Chani promised 15 s and was last heard 100 s ago (past deadline + grace + 2 x nextS: offline); Leto synced 10 s ago from a menu (in_menu).

cases.name: presence-bad-flag
cases.description: presence.inGame must be a JSON boolean: 1 is refused with 400 naming the field; nothing stored.

expectedResponse.title: Request body is invalid
expectedResponse.detail: presence.inGame is missing, unknown or out of range

cases.name: profile-upload
cases.description: POST /v1/profile stores the caller's profile under its character id and gives it the next profile rev.

cases.name: profile-same-again
cases.description: The same profile again keeps its rev (readers' cursors never bring it back) and only refreshes updatedAt.

cases.name: profile-delete
cases.description: profile null deletes the caller's stored profile: the next /v1/profiles no longer lists it.

cases.name: profiles-fetch
cases.description: POST /v1/profiles returns the battlegroup's profiles with rev > since (unchanged ones are not re-sent) and every listed character id. Each row carries playerTag: the same opaque 8-hex tag for every character of one key (HMAC-SHA256 of the key id under the stored secret hash), never the key id or the admin's label.

cases.name: profile-unknown-field
cases.description: A profile field outside the contract (here a currency in the session part) is refused and nothing is stored.

expectedResponse.title: Request body is invalid
expectedResponse.detail: profile.session.currencies is missing, unknown or out of range
